01 / THE SHIFT

Climate pressure isn't one problem. It's a conversation between land, weather, and time.

FieldShift brings those threads together in a farmer-first rotation explorer. Compare viable paths, understand trade-offs, and choose a strategy that fits your field—not a generic forecast.

02 / WHAT WE READ

The field speaks in signals.

NASA observations are paired with local soil context and crop needs to reveal what a rotation may ask of the land.
